Ear Training course · title

rows.source: Hear intervals and chords, and sing back what you hear
rows.translation: Prepoznavaj intervale in akorde ter ponovi s petjem, kar slišiš
rows.context: Ear Training course · course subtitle
Ear Training · Unit 1 “Higher or lower” · title

rows.source: Tell which of two notes is higher, from wide leaps down to the smallest step.
rows.translation: Ugotovi, kateri od dveh tonov je višji, od velikih skokov do najmanjšega koraka.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 “Higher or lower” · unit summary
Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-1 “High and low” · title

rows.source: Pitch is how high or low a note sounds. On a keyboard, low notes sit on the left and high notes on the right. Your ear already knows the difference; here you sharpen it.
rows.translation: Višina tona pove, kako visoko ali nizko zveni. Na klaviaturi so nizki toni levo in visoki desno. Tvoje uho razliko že pozna; tu jo izostriš.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-1 “High and low” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-1 “High and low” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: When the second note is higher, the melody moves up. When it's lower, it moves down. Trace the direction in the air with your hand as you listen.
rows.translation: Ko je drugi ton višji, se melodija premakne navzgor. Ko je nižji, gre navzdol. Med poslušanjem z roko zariši smer v zraku.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-1 “High and low” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Does the second note go up or down?
rows.translation: Gre drugi ton navzgor ali navzdol?
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-1 “High and low” · step 6 (listen) · question or instruction
Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-2 “Smaller leaps” · title
Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-2 “Smaller leaps” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: The closer two notes are, the harder they are to tell apart. Let each note finish before you answer. Every answer, right or wrong, trains your ear.
rows.translation: Bližje ko sta tona, težje ju ločiš. Pred odgovorom pusti vsakemu tonu izzveneti. Vsak odgovor, pravilen ali napačen, uri tvoje uho.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-2 “Smaller leaps” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-2 “Smaller leaps” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Not sure? Hum the first note, then slide your voice to the second. Feel whether your voice climbs or sinks. Your body knows the direction.
rows.translation: Nisi prepričan? Zamrmraj prvi ton, nato z glasom zdrsni do drugega. Začuti, ali se glas vzpenja ali spušča. Tvoje telo pozna smer.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-2 “Smaller leaps” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-3 “Next-door notes” · title

rows.source: Many melodies move to the very next note of the scale: a small step. Steps sound smooth and close. Listen for a gentle lift or dip instead of a jump.
rows.translation: Mnoge melodije se premaknejo na čisto naslednji ton lestvice: majhen korak. Koraki zvenijo gladko in blizu. Poslušaj nežen dvig ali spust namesto skoka.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-3 “Next-door notes” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-3 “Next-door notes” · step 6 (explain) · title

rows.source: Hold the first note in your head while the second one plays. Then compare them, like checking two heights side by side.
rows.translation: Prvi ton drži v mislih, medtem ko igra drugi. Nato ju primerjaj, kot bi drugo ob drugi primerjal dve višini.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-3 “Next-door notes” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text
Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-4 “The smallest step” · title
Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-4 “The smallest step” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: The smallest step in most music is the half step, also called a semitone: from one key on a keyboard to the very next. It's a tiny move, and you can learn to hear it.
rows.translation: Najmanjši korak v večini glasbe je polton: od ene tipke na klaviaturi do čisto naslednje. To je droben premik, ki se ga lahko naučiš slišati.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-4 “The smallest step” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-4 “The smallest step” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: With tiny steps, your first impression is usually right. Answer, and don't talk yourself out of it.
rows.translation: Pri drobnih korakih je prvi vtis običajno pravilen. Odgovori in se ne prepričuj v nasprotno.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-4 “The smallest step” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
Ear Training · Unit 1 · challenge ear-1-5 “Higher or lower challenge” · title
Ear Training · Unit 1 · challenge ear-1-5 “Higher or lower challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Wide leaps, small steps and half steps, high and low, all mixed together. Take a breath before each one.
rows.translation: Veliki skoki, majhni koraki in poltoni, visoko in nizko, vse pomešano. Pred vsakim vdihni.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 · challenge ear-1-5 “Higher or lower challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Ear Training · Unit 2 “Same or different” · title

rows.source: Hear when two notes match, then match a note with your voice or instrument.
rows.translation: Sliši, kdaj se tona ujemata, nato ton ponovi z glasom ali glasbilom.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 “Same or different” · unit summary
Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-1 “Same or different?” · title

rows.source: Two notes match when they have exactly the same pitch. Listen for whether the second note lands right on the first or slips away from it.
rows.translation: Tona se ujemata, ko imata točno isto višino. Poslušaj, ali drugi ton pristane na prvem ali se od njega odmakne.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-1 “Same or different?” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Two voices sing exactly the same pitch. What's that called?
rows.translation: Dva glasova pojeta točno isto višino tona. Kako temu pravimo?
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-1 “Same or different?” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-1 “Same or different?” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-1 “Same or different?” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-1 “Same or different?” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Singing in unison means singing the very same note.
rows.translation: Petje v unisonu pomeni petje povsem istega tona.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-1 “Same or different?” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-2 “Match a note” · title
Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-2 “Match a note” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: To match a pitch, listen, hear the note again in your head, then sing or play it. Timbre shows whether you're high or low. Slide until you land on it.
rows.translation: Za ujemanje višine poslušaj, ton znova zasliši v mislih, nato ga zapoj ali zaigraj. Timbre pokaže, ali si previsoko ali prenizko. Drsi, dokler ga ne zadeneš.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-2 “Match a note” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Sing or play back the note you just heard.
rows.translation: Zapoj ali zaigraj ton, ki si ga pravkar slišal.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-2 “Match a note” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Sing or play back the second note you heard.
rows.translation: Zapoj ali zaigraj drugi ton, ki si ga slišal.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-2 “Match a note” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-2 “Match a note” · step 6 (explain) · title

rows.source: If you're off, don't stop. Slide slowly up or down until the note locks in. That slide is how your ear and voice learn to agree.
rows.translation: Če zgrešiš, se ne ustavi. Počasi drsi navzgor ali navzdol, dokler se ton ne ujame. S tem drsenjem se uho in glas učita usklajevanja.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-2 “Match a note” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text
Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-3 “Hold it in your head” · title
Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-3 “Hold it in your head” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Before you sing, replay the note silently in your head. Musicians call this audiation: hearing music that isn't sounding. It's the heart of a good ear.
rows.translation: Preden zapoješ, ton tiho ponovi v mislih. Glasbeniki temu pravijo avdiacija: slišanje glasbe, ki dejansko ne zveni. To je srce dobrega posluha.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-3 “Hold it in your head” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Sing or play back the higher note.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-3 “Hold it in your head” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Sing or play back the lower note.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-3 “Hold it in your head” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-4 “Two notes back” · title
Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-4 “Two notes back” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Now match two notes in a row. Sing the first, then move to the second. Notice whether your voice climbs or drops to get there.
rows.translation: Zdaj ponovi dva tona zapored. Zapoj prvega, nato preidi na drugega. Opazi, ali se glas pri tem vzpenja ali spušča.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-4 “Two notes back” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Sing or play back the notes you just heard, in order.
rows.translation: Zapoj ali zaigraj pravkar slišane tone v istem vrstnem redu.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-4 “Two notes back” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Ear Training · Unit 2 · challenge ear-2-5 “Pitch match challenge” · title
Ear Training · Unit 2 · challenge ear-2-5 “Pitch match challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Same or different, single notes and pairs. Listen all the way through before you sing, and slide until each note settles.
rows.translation: Enako ali različno, posamezni toni in pari. Pred petjem poslušaj do konca in drsi, dokler se vsak ton ne ustali.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · challenge ear-2-5 “Pitch match challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Ear Training · Unit 3 “Steps and skips” · title

rows.source: Hear half steps and whole steps, then the wider skip of a third.
rows.translation: Sliši poltone in cele tone, nato širši preskok terce.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 3 “Steps and skips” · unit summary
Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-1 “Half steps and whole steps” · title
Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-1 “Half steps and whole steps” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A half step moves to the very next key. A whole step skips one key, so it equals two half steps. Both sound like steps, but a whole step opens a little wider.
rows.translation: Polton gre do čisto naslednje tipke. Cel ton preskoči eno tipko, zato je enak dvema poltonoma. Oba zvenita kot korak, a cel ton je malo širši.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-1 “Half steps and whole steps” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-1 “Half steps and whole steps” · step 2 (listen) · question or instruction
Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-1 “Half steps and whole steps” · step 2 (listen) · quiz answer
Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-1 “Half steps and whole steps” · step 2 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.source: How many half steps make a whole step?
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-1 “Half steps and whole steps” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: A whole step skips one key, so it's two half steps.
rows.translation: Cel ton preskoči eno tipko, zato je enak dvema poltonoma.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-1 “Half steps and whole steps” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-2 “Seconds” · title
Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-2 “Seconds” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Musicians call a step a second, because it moves to the next letter: C to D. A half step is a minor second. A whole step is a major second.
rows.translation: Glasbeniki koraku pravijo sekunda, saj gre do naslednje črke: od C do D. Polton je mala sekunda. Cel ton je velika sekunda.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-2 “Seconds” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-2 “Seconds” · step 2 (listen) · question or instruction
Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-2 “Seconds” · step 2 (listen) · quiz answer
Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-2 “Seconds” · step 2 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.source: E up to F is a...
rows.translation: Od E navzgor do F je ...
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-2 “Seconds” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-2 “Seconds” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: E and F have no key between them: a half step, so a minor second.
rows.translation: Med E in F ni tipke: polton, torej mala sekunda.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-2 “Seconds” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: C up to D is a...
rows.translation: Od C navzgor do D je ...
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-2 “Seconds” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: C to D skips the black key between them: a whole step, so a major second.
rows.translation: Od C do D preskočiš črno tipko med njima: cel ton, torej velika sekunda.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-2 “Seconds” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: A step moves to the next letter. A skip jumps over one, like C to E, skipping D. That gap is called a third. Skips sound more open than steps.
rows.translation: Korak gre do naslednje črke. Preskok eno izpusti, kot od C do E, kjer preskočiš D. Tej razdalji pravimo terca. Preskoki zvenijo bolj odprto kot koraki.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-3 “Steps and skips” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-3 “Steps and skips” · step 2 (listen) · question or instruction
Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-3 “Steps and skips” · step 2 (listen) · quiz answer
Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-3 “Steps and skips” · step 2 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.source: D up to F is a...
rows.translation: Od D navzgor do F je ...
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-3 “Steps and skips” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: D to F jumps over E, so it's a skip: a third.
rows.translation: Od D do F preskočiš E, zato je to preskok: terca.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-3 “Steps and skips” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-4 “Major and minor thirds” · title
Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-4 “Major and minor thirds” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A major third spans four half steps and sounds bright. A minor third spans three and sounds darker, a little wistful. Listen for the brightness.
rows.translation: Velika terca obsega štiri poltone in zveni svetlo. Mala terca obsega tri in zveni temneje, malo otožno. Poslušaj svetlost.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-4 “Major and minor thirds” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-4 “Major and minor thirds” · step 2 (listen) · quiz answer
Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-4 “Major and minor thirds” · step 2 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.source: C up to E spans how many half steps?
rows.translation: Koliko poltonov obsega interval od C navzgor do E?
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-4 “Major and minor thirds” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: C, C♯, D, D♯, E: four half steps, so it's a major third.
rows.translation: C, C♯, D, D♯, E: štirje poltoni, torej velika terca.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-4 “Major and minor thirds” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Ear Training · Unit 3 · challenge ear-3-5 “Steps and skips challenge” · title
Ear Training · Unit 3 · challenge ear-3-5 “Steps and skips challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Half steps, whole steps and thirds, rising and falling. Decide step or skip first, then the exact size.
rows.translation: Poltoni, celi toni in terce, navzgor in navzdol. Najprej določi korak ali preskok, nato točno velikost.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 3 · challenge ear-3-5 “Steps and skips challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Ear Training · Unit 4 “Intervals I” · title

rows.source: Unison, octave, fifth and fourth, each linked to a tune you can hum.
rows.translation: Unisono, oktava, kvinta in kvarta, vsak povezan z melodijo, ki jo lahko zamrmraš.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 “Intervals I” · unit summary
Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-1 “Unison and octave” · title
Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-1 “Unison and octave” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: An interval is the distance between two notes. A unison is no distance at all: the same note twice. An octave runs from one letter to the same letter above, like C to C. It sounds like one note, only brighter.
rows.translation: Interval je razdalja med tonoma. Pri unisonu razdalje sploh ni: isti ton dvakrat. Oktava gre od ene črke do iste črke višje, na primer od C do C. Zveni kot en ton, le svetleje.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-1 “Unison and octave” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-1 “Unison and octave” · step 2 (explain) · title

rows.source: Jingle Bells opens on one note repeated: a unison. Take Me Out to the Ball Game opens with a leap up an octave. Hum each opening to recall the sound.
rows.translation: Jingle Bells se začne s ponovljenim tonom: unisonom. Take Me Out to the Ball Game se začne s skokom za oktavo navzgor. Zamrmraj vsak začetek, da prikličeš zvok.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-1 “Unison and octave” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-1 “Unison and octave” · step 3 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.source: Why is it called an octave?
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-1 “Unison and octave” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-1 “Unison and octave” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-1 “Unison and octave” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-1 “Unison and octave” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: C, D, E, F, G, A, B, C: eight letter names, counting both ends.
rows.translation: C, D, E, F, G, A, B, C: osem črkovnih imen, če štejemo oba konca.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-1 “Unison and octave” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-2 “The perfect fifth” · title

rows.source: A perfect fifth spans seven half steps, like C up to G. It sounds open and strong. Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star leaps up a fifth after its first two notes.
rows.translation: Čista kvinta obsega sedem poltonov, kot od C navzgor do G. Zveni odprto in močno. Sveti, sveti, zvezdica po prvih dveh tonih skoči za kvinto navzgor.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-2 “The perfect fifth” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-2 “The perfect fifth” · step 2 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.source: What's a perfect fifth above D?
rows.translation: Kateri ton je čisto kvinto nad D?
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-2 “The perfect fifth” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Count five letters: D, E, F, G, A. D to A spans seven half steps.
rows.translation: Preštej pet črk: D, E, F, G, A. Od D do A je sedem poltonov.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-2 “The perfect fifth” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-3 “The perfect fourth” · title

rows.source: A perfect fourth spans five half steps, like C up to F. It sounds like a call to attention. Amazing Grace opens with a rising fourth.
rows.translation: Čista kvarta obsega pet poltonov, kot od C navzgor do F. Zveni kot poziv k pozornosti. Amazing Grace se začne z naraščajočo kvarto.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-3 “The perfect fourth” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-3 “The perfect fourth” · step 2 (listen) · quiz answer
Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-3 “The perfect fourth” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: Both sound open. The fifth is wider and feels settled. The fourth feels like it wants to move on. If you're unsure, hum the tune for each.
rows.translation: Obe zvenita odprto. Kvinta je širša in deluje umirjeno. Kvarta deluje, kot da želi naprej. Če nisi prepričan, za vsako zamrmraj melodijo.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-3 “The perfect fourth” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-3 “The perfect fourth” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction
Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-3 “The perfect fourth” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-3 “The perfect fourth” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A fifth spans seven half steps; a fourth spans five.
rows.translation: Kvinta obsega sedem poltonov; kvarta pet.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-3 “The perfect fourth” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-4 “Falling and together” · title
Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-4 “Falling and together” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: An interval keeps its name whether it rises or falls. G down to C is still a fifth. Listen to the size of the gap, not the direction.
rows.translation: Interval ohrani ime, ne glede na to, ali se vzpenja ali spušča. Od G navzdol do C je še vedno kvinta. Poslušaj velikost razdalje, ne smeri.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-4 “Falling and together” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: When two notes sound together, listen to the blend. An octave melts into one sound. A fifth sounds hollow and strong. A fourth sounds open but restless.
rows.translation: Ko tona zvenita skupaj, poslušaj zlitje. Oktava se zlije v en zvok. Kvinta zveni votlo in močno. Kvarta zveni odprto, a nemirno.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-4 “Falling and together” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Sing or play a falling fifth: G down to C.
rows.translation: Zapoj ali zaigraj padajočo kvinto: od G navzdol do C.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-4 “Falling and together” · step 9 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Ear Training · Unit 4 · challenge ear-4-5 “Intervals I challenge” · title
Ear Training · Unit 4 · challenge ear-4-5 “Intervals I challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Unison, octave, fifth and fourth, rising, falling and together. If you get stuck, hum the tune for each.
rows.translation: Unisono, oktava, kvinta in kvarta, navzgor, navzdol in skupaj. Če se zatakne, za vsakega zamrmraj melodijo.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 · challenge ear-4-5 “Intervals I challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Ear Training · Unit 5 “Intervals II” · title

rows.source: Thirds, sixths and seconds in their major and minor sizes.
rows.translation: Terce, sekste in sekunde v velikih in malih različicah.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 5 “Intervals II” · unit summary
Ear Training · Unit 5 · lesson ear-5-1 “Thirds you know” · title
Ear Training · Unit 5 · lesson ear-5-1 “Thirds you know” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: When the Saints Go Marching In opens with a major third, bright and bold. Greensleeves opens with a minor third, softer and sadder. Hum both to fix the sounds.
rows.translation: When the Saints Go Marching In se začne z veliko terco, svetlo in smelo. Greensleeves se začne z malo terco, nežneje in bolj žalostno. Zamrmraj obe, da si utrdiš zvoka.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 5 · lesson ear-5-1 “Thirds you know” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: How many half steps are in a minor third?
rows.translation: Koliko poltonov je v mali terci?
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 5 · lesson ear-5-1 “Thirds you know” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: A minor third spans three half steps, like A to C. A major third spans four.
rows.translation: Mala terca obsega tri poltone, kot od A do C. Velika terca obsega štiri.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 5 · lesson ear-5-1 “Thirds you know” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Ear Training · Unit 5 · lesson ear-5-2 “Sixths” · title

rows.source: A major sixth spans nine half steps; My Bonnie Lies Over the Ocean opens with one. A minor sixth spans eight and sounds darker. The Entertainer leaps up one right after its quick opening notes.
rows.translation: Velika seksta obsega devet poltonov; z njo se začne My Bonnie Lies Over the Ocean. Mala seksta obsega osem in zveni temneje. The Entertainer skoči za malo seksto navzgor takoj po hitrih začetnih tonih.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 5 · lesson ear-5-2 “Sixths” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Ear Training · Unit 5 · lesson ear-5-2 “Sixths” · step 2 (listen) · quiz answer
Ear Training · Unit 5 · lesson ear-5-2 “Sixths” · step 2 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.source: C up to A is which interval?
rows.translation: Kateri interval je od C navzgor do A?
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 5 · lesson ear-5-2 “Sixths” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: C to A spans nine half steps: a major sixth.
rows.translation: Od C do A je devet poltonov: velika seksta.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 5 · lesson ear-5-2 “Sixths” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Ear Training · Unit 5 · lesson ear-5-3 “Seconds you know” · title
Ear Training · Unit 5 · lesson ear-5-3 “Seconds you know” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Frère Jacques opens with a major second, a whole step up. Für Elise opens by rocking down and up a minor second, a half step. Small sizes, big difference.
rows.translation: Frère Jacques se začne z veliko sekundo, cel ton navzgor. Za Elizo se začne z zibanjem za malo sekundo navzdol in navzgor, za polton. Majhne razdalje, velika razlika.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 5 · lesson ear-5-3 “Seconds you know” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which interval is a half step?
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 5 · lesson ear-5-3 “Seconds you know” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: A minor second is one half step. A major second is two.
rows.translation: Mala sekunda je en polton. Velika sekunda sta dva.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 5 · lesson ear-5-3 “Seconds you know” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Sing or play the rocking half step: E, D♯, E.
rows.translation: Zapoj ali zaigraj zibajoči se polton: E, D♯, E.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 5 · lesson ear-5-3 “Seconds you know” · step 8 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Ear Training · Unit 5 · lesson ear-5-4 “Mixing sizes” · title
Ear Training · Unit 5 · lesson ear-5-4 “Mixing sizes” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: First judge the size: a step, a skip or a wide leap. Then judge the color: bright for major, darker for minor. Two easy choices beat one hard guess.
rows.translation: Najprej presodi velikost: korak, preskok ali velik skok. Nato barvo: svetlo za velike, temneje za male intervale. Dve lahki izbiri sta boljši kot eno težko ugibanje.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 5 · lesson ear-5-4 “Mixing sizes” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Ear Training · Unit 5 · lesson ear-5-4 “Mixing sizes” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ear Training · Unit 5 · lesson ear-5-4 “Mixing sizes” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Minor intervals sound darker than their major partners.
rows.translation: Mali intervali zvenijo temneje kot njihove velike različice.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 5 · lesson ear-5-4 “Mixing sizes” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Ear Training · Unit 5 · challenge ear-5-5 “Intervals II challenge” · title
Ear Training · Unit 5 · challenge ear-5-5 “Intervals II challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Seconds, thirds and sixths, major and minor, mixed with the fourths and fifths you already know.
rows.translation: Sekunde, terce in sekste, velike in male, pomešane s kvartami in kvintami, ki jih že poznaš.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 5 · challenge ear-5-5 “Intervals II challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Ear Training · Unit 6 “Chord qualities” · title

rows.source: Hear major and minor chords, then diminished, augmented and dominant seventh.
rows.translation: Prepoznaj durove in molove akorde, nato zmanjšane, zvečane in dominantne septakorde.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 6 “Chord qualities” · unit summary
Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-1 “Major or minor?” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A chord is three or more notes sounding together. A major chord sounds bright and settled. A minor chord sounds darker. Only the middle note differs between them.
rows.translation: Akord sestavljajo trije ali več tonov, ki zvenijo skupaj. Durov akord zveni svetlo in umirjeno. Molov zveni temneje. Razlikujeta se le v srednjem tonu.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-1 “Major or minor?” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: A major chord turns minor. How many of its notes change?
rows.translation: Durov akord se spremeni v molovega. Koliko tonov se spremeni?
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-1 “Major or minor?” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-1 “Major or minor?” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Only the middle note, the third, drops a half step: C E G becomes C E♭ G.
rows.translation: Le srednji ton, terca, se zniža za polton: C E G postane C E♭ G.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-1 “Major or minor?” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Sing or play back the chord's notes, low to high.
rows.translation: Zapoj ali zaigraj tone akorda od nizkega do visokega.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-1 “Major or minor?” · step 8 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-2 “Major and minor everywhere” · title
Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-2 “Major and minor everywhere” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Unsure? Focus on the middle note. In a major chord it sits four half steps above the bottom. In minor it sits one half step lower, which darkens everything.
rows.translation: Nisi prepričan? Osredotoči se na srednji ton. V durovem akordu je štiri poltone nad spodnjim. V molu je polton nižje, kar vse obarva temneje.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-2 “Major and minor everywhere” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which notes spell a C minor chord?
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-2 “Major and minor everywhere” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Lower the middle note of C major by a half step: E becomes E♭.
rows.translation: Srednji ton C-dura znižaj za polton: E postane E♭.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-2 “Major and minor everywhere” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-3 “Diminished and augmented” · title
Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-3 “Diminished and augmented” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A diminished chord stacks two minor thirds and sounds tight and uneasy. An augmented chord stacks two major thirds and sounds stretched, like a question left hanging.
rows.translation: Zmanjšani akord zloži dve mali terci in zveni tesno ter nemirno. Zvečani zloži dve veliki terci in zveni raztegnjeno, kot vprašanje brez odgovora.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-3 “Diminished and augmented” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which kind of chord is this?
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-3 “Diminished and augmented” · step 2 (listen) · question or instruction
Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-3 “Diminished and augmented” · step 2 (listen) · quiz answer
Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-3 “Diminished and augmented” · step 3 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.source: Which chord stacks two major thirds?
rows.translation: Kateri akord zloži dve veliki terci?
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-3 “Diminished and augmented” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: A major third plus a major third, like C E G♯, makes an augmented chord.
rows.translation: Velika terca in velika terca, na primer C E G♯, sestavita zvečani akord.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-3 “Diminished and augmented” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-4 “The dominant seventh” · title
Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-4 “The dominant seventh” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A dominant seventh chord is a major chord plus one more note on top: a minor seventh above the root, the note the chord is named for. It sounds bluesy and restless.
rows.translation: Dominantni septakord je durov akord z dodatnim tonom na vrhu: malo septimo nad osnovnim tonom, po katerem se akord imenuje. Zveni bluesovsko in nemirno.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-4 “The dominant seventh” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-4 “The dominant seventh” · step 2 (listen) · quiz answer
Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-4 “The dominant seventh” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: G7 is G major (G B D) plus F, a minor seventh above G.
rows.translation: G7 je G-dur (G B D) z dodanim F, malo septimo nad G.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-4 “The dominant seventh” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Ear Training · Unit 6 · challenge ear-6-5 “Chord qualities challenge” · title
Ear Training · Unit 6 · challenge ear-6-5 “Chord qualities challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Major, minor, diminished, augmented and dominant seventh: bright, dark, tight, stretched, restless. Name the color, then the chord.
rows.translation: Durov, molov, zmanjšan, zvečan in dominantni septakord: svetlo, temno, tesno, raztegnjeno, nemirno. Poimenuj barvo, nato akord.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 6 · challenge ear-6-5 “Chord qualities challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Ear Training · Unit 7 “Scale degrees” · title

rows.source: Hear each note's place in a key, from do, the home note, to ti.
rows.translation: Sliši mesto vsakega tona v tonaliteti, od do, domačega tona, do ti.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 7 “Scale degrees” · unit summary
Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-1 “Do, the home note” · title
Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-1 “Do, the home note” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Every key has a home note called the tonic. Singers call it do. Here you'll hear a chord that sets the key, then a single note to place.
rows.translation: Vsaka tonaliteta ima domači ton, imenovan tonika. Pevci mu pravijo do. Tu zaslišiš akord, ki določi tonaliteto, nato posamezen ton, ki ga umestiš.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-1 “Do, the home note” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Is the last note do, the home note?
rows.translation: Je zadnji ton do, domači ton?
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-1 “Do, the home note” · step 2 (listen) · question or instruction
Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-1 “Do, the home note” · step 2 (listen) · quiz answer
Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-1 “Do, the home note” · step 2 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.source: The notes of a major scale are do, re, mi, fa, sol, la, ti, then do again. Each is a scale degree, numbered from do: do is 1, re is 2, up to ti, 7.
rows.translation: Toni durove lestvice so do, re, mi, fa, sol, la, ti in nato spet do. Vsak je lestvična stopnja, šteta od do: do je 1, re je 2, vse do ti, 7.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-1 “Do, the home note” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which scale degree is the last note?
rows.translation: Katera lestvična stopnja je zadnji ton?
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-1 “Do, the home note” · step 6 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.source: Sing or play do, re, mi in C major: C, D, E.
rows.translation: Zapoj ali zaigraj do, re, mi v C-duru: C, D, E.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-1 “Do, the home note” · step 8 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-2 “Do, mi and sol” · title
Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-2 “Do, mi and sol” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Do, mi and sol are the notes of the home chord, so they sound stable and at rest. Mi sounds sweet, sol sounds strong and open, and do sounds finished.
rows.translation: Do, mi in sol so toni domačega akorda, zato zvenijo stabilno in mirno. Mi zveni sladko, sol močno in odprto, do pa zaključeno.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-2 “Do, mi and sol” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In C major, which note is sol?
rows.translation: Kateri ton je sol v C-duru?
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-2 “Do, mi and sol” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Count up from do: C do, D re, E mi, F fa, G sol.
rows.translation: Štej navzgor od do: C do, D re, E mi, F fa, G sol.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-2 “Do, mi and sol” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Sing or play do, mi, sol in G major: G, B, D.
rows.translation: Zapoj ali zaigraj do, mi, sol v G-duru: G, B, D.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-2 “Do, mi and sol” · step 8 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-3 “Notes that lean” · title

rows.source: Re, fa, la and ti sound unfinished. Ti sits a half step below do and pulls hard upward. Fa leans down to mi. Re and la want to step to a neighbor.
rows.translation: Re, fa, la in ti zvenijo nedokončano. Ti je polton pod do in močno teži navzgor. Fa teži navzdol k mi. Re in la želita stopiti k sosedu.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-3 “Notes that lean” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which note pulls most strongly up to do?
rows.translation: Kateri ton najmočneje teži navzgor k do?
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-3 “Notes that lean” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Ti sits just a half step below do, so it leans hard toward it.
rows.translation: Ti je le polton pod do, zato močno teži k njemu.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-3 “Notes that lean” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Sing or play ti rising to do in C major: B, then C.
rows.translation: Zapoj ali zaigraj ti, ki se vzpne do do v C-duru: B, nato C.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-3 “Notes that lean” · step 9 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-4 “All seven, after a cadence” · title

rows.source: Set the key with a cadence
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-4 “All seven, after a cadence” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A cadence is a short chord pattern that ends a phrase. Hearing one sets the key firmly. Sing do quietly to yourself, then measure the new note from there.
rows.translation: Kadenca je kratko akordno zaporedje, ki konča frazo. Ko jo slišiš, jasno določi tonaliteto. Tiho si zapoj do, nato od tam odmeri novi ton.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-4 “All seven, after a cadence” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Why play a cadence before the note?
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-4 “All seven, after a cadence” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-4 “All seven, after a cadence” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-4 “All seven, after a cadence” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-4 “All seven, after a cadence” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The chords point to do, so you can hear every other note in relation to it.
rows.translation: Akordi pokažejo na do, zato vsak drug ton slišiš v odnosu do njega.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-4 “All seven, after a cadence” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Sing or play up the scale from do in C major: C, D, E, F, G.
rows.translation: Zapoj ali zaigraj lestvico navzgor od do v C-duru: C, D, E, F, G.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 7 · lesson ear-7-4 “All seven, after a cadence” · step 9 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Ear Training · Unit 7 · challenge ear-7-5 “Scale degrees challenge” · title
Ear Training · Unit 7 · challenge ear-7-5 “Scale degrees challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Chords set the key, then one note plays. Find do first, then name the note. Every key works the same way.
rows.translation: Akordi določijo tonaliteto, nato zazveni en ton. Najprej poišči do, nato ton poimenuj. Vsaka tonaliteta deluje enako.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 7 · challenge ear-7-5 “Scale degrees challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Sing or play do, ti, do in D major: D, C♯, D.
rows.translation: Zapoj ali zaigraj do, ti, do v D-duru: D, C♯, D.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 7 · challenge ear-7-5 “Scale degrees challenge” · step 9 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Ear Training · Unit 8 “Melodic dictation” · title

rows.source: Hear short melodies, pick out the one you heard, and sing it back.
rows.translation: Poslušaj kratke melodije, izberi slišano in jo ponovi s petjem.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 8 “Melodic dictation” · unit summary
Ear Training · Unit 8 · lesson ear-8-1 “Three-note melodies” · title

rows.source: Dictation means hearing a melody and writing it down. Here you pick it from a list. Find do from the chord, then follow each move: up or down, step or skip.
rows.translation: Narek pomeni slišati melodijo in jo zapisati. Tu jo izbereš s seznama. Iz akorda poišči do, nato sledi vsakemu premiku: gor ali dol, korak ali preskok.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 8 · lesson ear-8-1 “Three-note melodies” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Ear Training · Unit 8 · lesson ear-8-1 “Three-note melodies” · step 2 (listen) · question or instruction
Ear Training · Unit 8 · lesson ear-8-1 “Three-note melodies” · step 6 (explain) · title

rows.source: Before naming notes, trace the shape with your hand: up, down or bending. Most wrong answers have the wrong shape, so you can rule them out fast.
rows.translation: Pred poimenovanjem tonov z roko zariši obliko: navzgor, navzdol ali z obratom. Večina napačnih odgovorov ima napačno obliko, zato jih hitro izločiš.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 8 · lesson ear-8-1 “Three-note melodies” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text
Ear Training · Unit 8 · lesson ear-8-2 “Skips in a melody” · title
Ear Training · Unit 8 · lesson ear-8-2 “Skips in a melody” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Steps sound smooth; skips jump out. When you hear a jump, check whether it lands on a note of the home chord: do, mi or sol.
rows.translation: Koraki zvenijo gladko; preskoki izstopijo. Ko slišiš skok, preveri, ali pristane na tonu domačega akorda: do, mi ali sol.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 8 · lesson ear-8-2 “Skips in a melody” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: A melody goes do, mi, sol. How does it move?
rows.translation: Melodija gre do, mi, sol. Kako se premika?
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 8 · lesson ear-8-2 “Skips in a melody” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
Ear Training · Unit 8 · lesson ear-8-2 “Skips in a melody” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ear Training · Unit 8 · lesson ear-8-2 “Skips in a melody” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ear Training · Unit 8 · lesson ear-8-2 “Skips in a melody” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Do to mi skips re, and mi to sol skips fa.
rows.translation: Od do do mi preskočiš re, od mi do sol pa fa.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 8 · lesson ear-8-2 “Skips in a melody” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Ear Training · Unit 8 · lesson ear-8-3 “Four-note melodies” · title
Ear Training · Unit 8 · lesson ear-8-3 “Four-note melodies” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Longer melodies use the same tools. Lock in the first note against do, then take the rest one move at a time.
rows.translation: Daljše melodije uporabljajo ista orodja. Prvi ton določi glede na do, nato drugega za drugim sledi preostalim premikom.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 8 · lesson ear-8-3 “Four-note melodies” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: A melody stops on ti. How does it sound?
rows.translation: Melodija se ustavi na ti. Kako zveni?
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 8 · lesson ear-8-3 “Four-note melodies” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction
Ear Training · Unit 8 · lesson ear-8-3 “Four-note melodies” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ear Training · Unit 8 · lesson ear-8-3 “Four-note melodies” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ear Training · Unit 8 · lesson ear-8-3 “Four-note melodies” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Ti leans up to do, so a melody that stops on ti feels like it's waiting.
rows.translation: Ti teži navzgor k do, zato melodija, ki se ustavi na ti, deluje, kot da čaka.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 8 · lesson ear-8-3 “Four-note melodies” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Ear Training · Unit 8 · lesson ear-8-4 “Below do” · title

rows.source: Melodies often dip under do to ti, la or sol below. They're the same notes, just lower. Many tunes start on sol below and leap up to do.
rows.translation: Melodije se pogosto spustijo pod do do nižjih ti, la ali sol. To so isti toni, le nižje. Mnoge viže se začnejo na spodnjem sol in skočijo navzgor do do.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 8 · lesson ear-8-4 “Below do” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Amazing Grace starts on sol below do and leaps up. To which note?
rows.translation: Amazing Grace se začne na sol pod do in skoči navzgor. Do katerega tona?
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 8 · lesson ear-8-4 “Below do” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Sol up to do is a perfect fourth, the interval you learned with this tune.
rows.translation: Od sol navzgor do do je čista kvarta, interval, ki si ga spoznal s to melodijo.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 8 · lesson ear-8-4 “Below do” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Ear Training · Unit 8 · challenge ear-8-5 “Dictation challenge” · title

rows.source: Hear it, find it, sing it
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 8 · challenge ear-8-5 “Dictation challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Chords first, then the melody. Find do, trace the shape, name each note, then sing or play it back.
rows.translation: Najprej akordi, nato melodija. Poišči do, zariši obliko, poimenuj vsak ton, nato ponovi s petjem ali igranjem.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 8 · challenge ear-8-5 “Dictation challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Music Theory course · title

rows.source: How music works, from note names to the chords behind songs
rows.translation: Kako deluje glasba, od imen tonov do akordov v pesmih
rows.context: Music Theory course · course subtitle
Music Theory · Unit 1 “Notes and the alphabet” · title

rows.source: Seven letters, repeating octaves, and where every note lives on a keyboard.
rows.translation: Sedem črk, ponavljajoče se oktave in mesto vsakega tona na klaviaturi.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 “Notes and the alphabet” · unit summary
Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-1 “The musical alphabet” · title
Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-1 “The musical alphabet” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Music names its notes with just seven letters: A, B, C, D, E, F, G. After G the alphabet starts again at A, a little higher each time around.
rows.translation: Glasba poimenuje tone s samo sedmimi črkami: A, B, C, D, E, F, G. Po G se abeceda znova začne pri A, vsakič malo višje.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-1 “The musical alphabet” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-1 “The musical alphabet” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: The musical alphabet stops at G and starts again at A.
rows.translation: Glasbena abeceda se ustavi pri G in znova začne pri A.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-1 “The musical alphabet” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Which letter comes just before C?
rows.translation: Katera črka je tik pred C?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-1 “The musical alphabet” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Going down, the alphabet runs C, B, A, then G.
rows.translation: Navzdol gre abeceda C, B, A, nato G.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-1 “The musical alphabet” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-1 “The musical alphabet” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: Moving forward through the letters, A to B to C, the notes go up. Moving backward, they go down. The letters loop like the hours on a clock.
rows.translation: Ko greš po črkah naprej, od A do B do C, gredo toni navzgor. Ko greš nazaj, gredo navzdol. Črke krožijo kot ure na številčnici.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-1 “The musical alphabet” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: What are the next two letters after F?
rows.translation: Kateri sta naslednji dve črki za F?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-1 “The musical alphabet” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: F, G, then back around to A.
rows.translation: F, G, nato nazaj na A.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-1 “The musical alphabet” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-1 “The musical alphabet” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Backward through the alphabet means lower notes: E, D, C, B.
rows.translation: Nazaj po abecedi pomeni nižje tone: E, D, C, B.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-1 “The musical alphabet” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Play or sing C, D, E, climbing up the alphabet.
rows.translation: Zaigraj ali zapoj C, D, E in se vzpenjaj po abecedi.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-1 “The musical alphabet” · step 7 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-2 “Octaves” · title
Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-2 “Octaves” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Notes that share a letter sound alike even when one is higher. The distance from one C to the next C is an octave. The higher note vibrates exactly twice as fast.
rows.translation: Toni z isto črko zvenijo podobno, tudi če je eden višji. Razdalja od enega C do naslednjega C je oktava. Višji ton niha točno dvakrat hitreje.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-2 “Octaves” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Do these two notes share a letter name?
rows.translation: Imata ta tona isto črkovno ime?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-2 “Octaves” · step 2 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.source: A4 vibrates 440 times a second. How fast does A5 vibrate?
rows.translation: A4 zaniha 440-krat na sekundo. Kako hitro niha A5?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-2 “Octaves” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-2 “Octaves” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-2 “Octaves” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-2 “Octaves” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: An octave up doubles the vibration: 440 becomes 880.
rows.translation: Oktava navzgor podvoji frekvenco nihanja: 440 postane 880.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-2 “Octaves” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-2 “Octaves” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Notes carry a number that tells you which octave they're in. Middle C, near the center of a piano, is C4. The number goes up by one at every C.
rows.translation: Toni imajo številko, ki pove, v kateri oktavi so. Srednji C blizu sredine klavirja je C4. Številka se pri vsakem C poveča za ena.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-2 “Octaves” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which note is just above B3?
rows.translation: Kateri ton je tik nad B3?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-2 “Octaves” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Octave numbers change at C, so the next note up from B3 is C4.
rows.translation: Številke oktav se zamenjajo pri C, zato je naslednji ton nad B3 C4.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-2 “Octaves” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Play or sing middle C, then the C an octave higher.
rows.translation: Zaigraj ali zapoj srednji C, nato C oktavo višje.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-2 “Octaves” · step 8 (notes) · hint under an exercise

Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-3 “The keyboard map” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A keyboard's black keys come in groups of two and three. They're your map. C is the white key just left of each group of two.
rows.translation: Črne tipke na klaviaturi so v skupinah po dve in tri. To je tvoj zemljevid. C je bela tipka tik levo od vsake dvojice.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-3 “The keyboard map” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-3 “The keyboard map” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: C sits just left of the group of two black keys.
rows.translation: C je tik levo od skupine dveh črnih tipk.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-3 “The keyboard map” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: F and the group of three
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-3 “The keyboard map” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: F is the white key just left of each group of three black keys. Find C and F first, and every other white key is a short count away.
rows.translation: F je bela tipka tik levo od vsake skupine treh črnih tipk. Najprej poišči C in F, do vsake druge bele tipke pa je le malo štetja.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-3 “The keyboard map” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: F sits just left of the group of three black keys.
rows.translation: F je tik levo od skupine treh črnih tipk.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-3 “The keyboard map” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: D sits between the two black keys of the pair.
rows.translation: D leži med črnima tipkama v dvojici.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-3 “The keyboard map” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: B is the white key just right of the group of three black keys.
rows.translation: B je bela tipka tik desno od skupine treh črnih tipk.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-3 “The keyboard map” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Play or sing F, G, A, starting from the F you just found.
rows.translation: Zaigraj ali zapoj F, G, A, začenši s F, ki si ga pravkar našel.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-3 “The keyboard map” · step 7 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-4 “Every white key” · title
Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-4 “Every white key” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: From C, the white keys run C, D, E, F, G, A, B, then C again. Seven white keys hold one of each letter.
rows.translation: Od C gredo bele tipke C, D, E, F, G, A, B in spet C. Sedem belih tipk vsebuje po eno vsake črke.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-4 “Every white key” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: G sits between the first two black keys of the group of three.
rows.translation: G leži med prvima črnima tipkama skupine treh.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-4 “Every white key” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: E is the white key just right of the group of two black keys.
rows.translation: E je bela tipka tik desno od skupine dveh črnih tipk.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-4 “Every white key” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: A sits between the last two black keys of the group of three.
rows.translation: A leži med zadnjima črnima tipkama skupine treh.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-4 “Every white key” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: How many white keys run from one C up to the next B?
rows.translation: Koliko belih tipk je od C navzgor do naslednjega B?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-4 “Every white key” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: C, D, E, F, G, A, B: seven letters, seven white keys.
rows.translation: C, D, E, F, G, A, B: sedem črk, sedem belih tipk.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-4 “Every white key” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Play or sing up the white keys from middle C to the next C.
rows.translation: Zaigraj ali zapoj navzgor po belih tipkah od srednjega C do naslednjega C.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-4 “Every white key” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise

Music Theory · Unit 1 · challenge thy-1-5 “Notes and letters challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: The alphabet, octaves and the keyboard map, all together. Use the black-key groups to find your way.
rows.translation: Abeceda, oktave in zemljevid klaviature skupaj. Za orientacijo uporabi skupine črnih tipk.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · challenge thy-1-5 “Notes and letters challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which two letters come right after E?
rows.translation: Kateri dve črki prideta takoj za E?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · challenge thy-1-5 “Notes and letters challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: E, F, G: forward through the alphabet.
rows.translation: E, F, G: naprej po abecedi.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · challenge thy-1-5 “Notes and letters challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Middle C is C4. What's the C an octave above it?
rows.translation: Srednji C je C4. Kateri C je oktavo nad njim?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · challenge thy-1-5 “Notes and letters challenge” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Each octave up adds one to the number.
rows.translation: Vsaka oktava navzgor številki prišteje ena.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · challenge thy-1-5 “Notes and letters challenge” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Play or sing G, A, B, C. The alphabet wraps from G back to A.
rows.translation: Zaigraj ali zapoj G, A, B, C. Abeceda se od G vrne na A.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · challenge thy-1-5 “Notes and letters challenge” · step 8 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: The black keys, the smallest step, and notes with two names.
rows.translation: Črne tipke, najmanjši korak in toni z dvema imenoma.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 “Sharps, flats and half steps” · unit summary
Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-1 “Half steps” · title

rows.source: A half step moves from one key to the very next, black or white, with nothing in between. It's the smallest distance on a keyboard and in most music.
rows.translation: Polton gre od ene tipke do čisto naslednje, črne ali bele, brez vmesne tipke. To je najmanjša razdalja na klaviaturi in v večini glasbe.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-1 “Half steps” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: What is a half step above E?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-1 “Half steps” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: E and F have no black key between them.
rows.translation: Med E in F ni črne tipke.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-1 “Half steps” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-1 “Half steps” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: Look for the gaps with no black key: E to F and B to C. These white keys sit right next to each other, so they're only a half step apart.
rows.translation: Poišči vrzeli brez črne tipke: od E do F in od B do C. Te bele tipke so neposredno druga ob drugi, zato je med njimi le polton.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-1 “Half steps” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which pair of white keys is a half step apart?
rows.translation: Kateri par belih tipk je polton narazen?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-1 “Half steps” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-1 “Half steps” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-1 “Half steps” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: B and C have no black key between them.
rows.translation: Med B in C ni črne tipke.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-1 “Half steps” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: How many half steps from C up to E?
rows.translation: Koliko poltonov je od C navzgor do E?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-1 “Half steps” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: C, C♯, D, D♯, E: four moves of one key each.
rows.translation: C, C♯, D, D♯, E: štirje premiki, vsak za eno tipko.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-1 “Half steps” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Play or sing the two white-key half steps: E to F, then B to C.
rows.translation: Zaigraj ali zapoj oba poltona na belih tipkah: od E do F, nato od B do C.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-1 “Half steps” · step 7 (notes) · hint under an exercise

Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-2 “Sharps and flats” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A sharp (♯) raises a note by a half step. A flat (♭) lowers it by a half step. The black key just above C is C♯; the one just below D is D♭.
rows.translation: Višaj (♯) zviša ton za polton. Nižaj (♭) ga zniža za polton. Črna tipka tik nad C je C♯; tista tik pod D je D♭.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-2 “Sharps and flats” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: What does a sharp do to a note?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-2 “Sharps and flats” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-2 “Sharps and flats” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer
Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-2 “Sharps and flats” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer
Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-2 “Sharps and flats” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: This black key sits just above F. What's its sharp name?
rows.translation: Ta črna tipka je tik nad F. Kako se imenuje z višajem?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-2 “Sharps and flats” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Raise F by a half step and you get F♯.
rows.translation: Zvišaj F za polton in dobiš F♯.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-2 “Sharps and flats” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: The same key sits just below G. What's its flat name?
rows.translation: Ista tipka je tik pod G. Kako se imenuje z nižajem?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-2 “Sharps and flats” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Lower G by a half step and you get G♭.
rows.translation: Znižaj G za polton in dobiš G♭.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-2 “Sharps and flats” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-2 “Sharps and flats” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Each black key can be named from the white key below it, with a sharp, or the white key above it, with a flat. C♯ and D♭ are the same key.
rows.translation: Vsako črno tipko lahko poimenuješ po beli tipki pod njo z višajem ali po beli nad njo z nižajem. C♯ in D♭ sta ista tipka.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-2 “Sharps and flats” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: What is a half step below B?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-2 “Sharps and flats” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Lower B by a half step and you get B♭.
rows.translation: Znižaj B za polton in dobiš B♭.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-2 “Sharps and flats” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: It's the right-hand key of the pair, just above D: D♯.
rows.translation: To je desna tipka dvojice, tik nad D: D♯.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-2 “Sharps and flats” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Play or sing C, C♯, D: two half steps up.
rows.translation: Zaigraj ali zapoj C, C♯, D: dva poltona navzgor.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-2 “Sharps and flats” · step 8 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-3 “Whole steps” · title
Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-3 “Whole steps” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A whole step equals two half steps: it skips exactly one key. C to D is a whole step, with C♯ in between. E to F♯ is too.
rows.translation: Cel ton je enak dvema poltonoma: preskoči točno eno tipko. Od C do D je cel ton, z vmesnim C♯. Tudi od E do F♯.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-3 “Whole steps” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: What is a whole step above C?
rows.translation: Kaj je cel ton nad C?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-3 “Whole steps” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: C to D skips one key, C♯.
rows.translation: Od C do D preskočiš eno tipko, C♯.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-3 “Whole steps” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: What is a whole step above E?
rows.translation: Kaj je cel ton nad E?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-3 “Whole steps” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: E to F is only a half step, so a whole step up is F♯.
rows.translation: Od E do F je le polton, zato je cel ton višje F♯.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-3 “Whole steps” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: What is a whole step above B?
rows.translation: Kaj je cel ton nad B?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-3 “Whole steps” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: B to C is a half step, so a whole step up is C♯.
rows.translation: Od B do C je polton, zato je cel ton višje C♯.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-3 “Whole steps” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: What is a whole step below F?
rows.translation: Kaj je cel ton pod F?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-3 “Whole steps” · step 7 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: F down to E is a half step; one more key down is E♭.
rows.translation: Od F navzdol do E je polton; še eno tipko nižje je E♭.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-3 “Whole steps” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Play or sing two whole steps up from E: E, F♯, G♯.
rows.translation: Zaigraj ali zapoj dva cela tona navzgor od E: E, F♯, G♯.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-3 “Whole steps” · step 8 (notes) · hint under an exercise

Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-4 “One key, two names” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Two names for the same pitch are called enharmonic. C♯ and D♭ are one key with two names. Which name you use depends on the key you're in.
rows.translation: Dvema imenoma za isto višino tona pravimo enharmonični. C♯ in D♭ sta ena tipka z dvema imenoma. Katero ime uporabiš, je odvisno od tonalitete.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-4 “One key, two names” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which pair names the same key?

Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-4 “One key, two names” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: C♯ is a half step above C; D♭ is a half step below D. Same key.
rows.translation: C♯ je polton nad C; D♭ je polton pod D. Ista tipka.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-4 “One key, two names” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-4 “One key, two names” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: G♯ and A♭ are the same black key.
rows.translation: G♯ in A♭ sta ista črna tipka.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-4 “One key, two names” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-4 “One key, two names” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: White keys can have sharp or flat names as well. E and F are a half step apart, so E♯ is the same key as F, and F♭ is the same key as E.
rows.translation: Tudi bele tipke imajo lahko imena z višajem ali nižajem. E in F sta polton narazen, zato je E♯ ista tipka kot F, F♭ pa ista tipka kot E.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-4 “One key, two names” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: E♯ is played on which key?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-4 “One key, two names” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: E♯ is a half step above E, which is F.
rows.translation: E♯ je polton nad E, torej F.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-4 “One key, two names” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-4 “One key, two names” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: B♯ is a half step above B, which is C.
rows.translation: B♯ je polton nad B, torej C.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-4 “One key, two names” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: The black key between F and G is F♯. What's its other name?
rows.translation: Črna tipka med F in G je F♯. Kako ji še rečemo?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-4 “One key, two names” · step 7 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Play or sing B♭, C, D. B♭ is the same key as A♯.
rows.translation: Zaigraj ali zapoj B♭, C, D. B♭ je ista tipka kot A♯.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-4 “One key, two names” · step 8 (notes) · hint under an exercise

Music Theory · Unit 2 · challenge thy-2-5 “Sharps and flats challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Half steps, whole steps, sharps, flats and two-name notes, all mixed together. Picture the keyboard as you answer.
rows.translation: Poltoni, celi toni, višaji, nižaji in toni z dvema imenoma, vse pomešano. Med odgovarjanjem si predstavljaj klaviaturo.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · challenge thy-2-5 “Sharps and flats challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Kaj je cel ton nad A?

rows.source: A to B skips one key, A♯.
rows.translation: Od A do B preskočiš eno tipko, A♯.

Music Theory · Unit 2 · challenge thy-2-5 “Sharps and flats challenge” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: E♭ and D♯ are the same black key.
rows.translation: E♭ in D♯ sta ista črna tipka.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · challenge thy-2-5 “Sharps and flats challenge” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: It's the top key of the group of three, just below B: A♯, also called B♭.
rows.translation: To je najvišja tipka skupine treh, tik pod B: A♯, imenovana tudi B♭.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · challenge thy-2-5 “Sharps and flats challenge” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: What is a whole step below D?
rows.translation: Kaj je cel ton pod D?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · challenge thy-2-5 “Sharps and flats challenge” · step 7 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: D to C skips one key, C♯.
rows.translation: Od D do C preskočiš eno tipko, C♯.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · challenge thy-2-5 “Sharps and flats challenge” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Play or sing D, E, F♯, G: whole, whole, then half.
rows.translation: Zaigraj ali zapoj D, E, F♯, G: cel ton, cel ton, nato polton.

rows.source: Music is written on a staff: five lines with four spaces between them. Notes sit on a line or in a space. The higher a note sits, the higher it sounds.
rows.translation: Glasbo zapisujemo na notno črtovje: pet črt s štirimi prazninami med njimi. Note so na črti ali v praznini. Višje ko je nota, višje zveni.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-1 “Lines and spaces” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: How many lines does a staff have?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-1 “Lines and spaces” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Five lines, with four spaces between them.
rows.translation: Pet črt s štirimi prazninami med njimi.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-1 “Lines and spaces” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-1 “Lines and spaces” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: It sits higher on the staff, so it sounds higher.
rows.translation: Na črtovju je višje, zato zveni višje.

rows.source: Moving up one letter moves from a line to the next space, or from a space to the next line. Notes on neighboring lines are two letters apart.
rows.translation: Premik za eno črko navzgor gre s črte v naslednjo praznino ali iz praznine na naslednjo črto. Note na sosednjih črtah so dve črki narazen.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-1 “Lines and spaces” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: A note on a line moves up one letter. Where does it land?
rows.translation: Nota na črti se premakne za eno črko navzgor. Kje pristane?

Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-1 “Lines and spaces” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Letters alternate: line, space, line, space.
rows.translation: Črke se izmenjujejo: črta, praznina, črta, praznina.
