Singing · Unit 3 · lesson voc-3-4 “Five-note patterns” · step 3 (listen) · quiz answer
Singing · Unit 3 · lesson voc-3-4 “Five-note patterns” · step 3 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.source: Do up to sol and back: C to G to C.
rows.translation: Od do navzgor do sol in nazaj: od C do G do C.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 3 · lesson voc-3-4 “Five-note patterns” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Sing C-D-E-D-C, then the same shape one step higher. What's the top note now?
rows.translation: Zapoj C-D-E-D-C, nato isti vzorec korak višje. Kateri je zdaj najvišji ton?
rows.context: Singing · Unit 3 · lesson voc-3-4 “Five-note patterns” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: One step higher, the shape becomes D, E, F, E, D.
rows.translation: Korak višje vzorec postane D, E, F, E, D.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 3 · lesson voc-3-4 “Five-note patterns” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Singing · Unit 3 · lesson voc-3-4 “Five-note patterns” · step 6 (along) · title
Singing · Unit 3 · challenge voc-3-5 “Scale check” · title

rows.source: Breathe low before each scale, keep the top light, and keep lower notes bright on the way down.
rows.translation: Pred vsako lestvico nizko vdihni, vrh ohrani lahkoten, nižje tone pa svetle med spuščanjem.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 3 · challenge voc-3-5 “Scale check” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: How many notes are in a major scale, do to do?
rows.translation: Koliko tonov je v durovi lestvici od do do do?
rows.context: Singing · Unit 3 · challenge voc-3-5 “Scale check” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Do, re, mi, fa, sol, la, ti, do: eight notes, with do at both ends.
rows.translation: Do, re, mi, fa, sol, la, ti, do: osem tonov, z do na obeh koncih.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 3 · challenge voc-3-5 “Scale check” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Singing · Unit 3 · challenge voc-3-5 “Scale check” · step 5 (listen) · quiz answer
Singing · Unit 3 · challenge voc-3-5 “Scale check” · step 7 (along) · title
Singing · Unit 4 “Intervals you can sing” · title

rows.source: Leap by thirds, fifths and octaves, and land in tune.
rows.translation: Skači v tercah, kvintah in oktavah ter pristani čisto.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 4 “Intervals you can sing” · unit summary
Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-1 “Thirds” · title
Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-1 “Thirds” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: An interval is the distance between two notes. Skip one scale step and you get a third, like do to mi. Hear mi in your head before you leave do.
rows.translation: Interval je razdalja med tonoma. Preskoči eno lestvično stopnjo in dobiš terco, kot od do do mi. V mislih zasliši mi, preden zapustiš do.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-1 “Thirds” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Do to mi and back: C, E, C.
rows.translation: Od do do mi in nazaj: C, E, C.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-1 “Thirds” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-1 “Thirds” · step 3 (listen) · question or instruction
Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-1 “Thirds” · step 3 (listen) · quiz answer
Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-1 “Thirds” · step 3 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Še ena terca: D, F, D.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-1 “Thirds” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-1 “Thirds” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-1 “Thirds” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: C to E skips over D, so it spans three scale notes: a third.
rows.translation: Od C do E preskočiš D, zato obsega tri lestvične tone: terco.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-1 “Thirds” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-1 “Thirds” · step 6 (along) · title
Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-2 “Fifths” · title
Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-2 “Fifths” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Do to sol spans five scale notes, a fifth. It sounds open and strong. Picture the steps in between, then jump straight to sol.
rows.translation: Od do do sol je pet lestvičnih tonov, kvinta. Zveni odprto in močno. Predstavljaj si vmesne stopnje, nato skoči naravnost na sol.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-2 “Fifths” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Do to sol and back: C, G, C.
rows.translation: Od do do sol in nazaj: C, G, C.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-2 “Fifths” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-2 “Fifths” · step 3 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.source: Do, mi, sol: two thirds stack up to a fifth.
rows.translation: Do, mi, sol: dve terci se zložita v kvinto.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-2 “Fifths” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Counting both ends, how many scale notes from do to sol?
rows.translation: Koliko lestvičnih tonov je od do do sol, če šteješ oba konca?
rows.context: Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-2 “Fifths” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Do, re, mi, fa, sol: five notes, so it's a fifth.
rows.translation: Do, re, mi, fa, sol: pet tonov, torej kvinta.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-2 “Fifths” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-3 “The octave” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: An octave leaps from do to the next do, eight scale notes up. The two notes share a name and blend so well they almost sound like one.
rows.translation: Oktava skoči od do do naslednjega do, osem lestvičnih tonov navzgor. Tona imata isto ime in se tako dobro zlijeta, da skoraj zvenita kot eden.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-3 “The octave” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-3 “The octave” · step 2 (listen) · question or instruction
Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-3 “The octave” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: Before an octave leap, breathe low and keep your chin level. Think of the top note as light and easy, not a stretch upward.
rows.translation: Pred oktavnim skokom nizko vdihni in brado ohrani ravno. Zgornji ton si predstavljaj kot lahkoten in preprost, ne kot raztezanje navzgor.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-3 “The octave” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: C, then G, then the high C. Use the G as a stepping stone.
rows.translation: C, nato G, nato visoki C. G uporabi kot vmesno oporo.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-3 “The octave” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Why do the two notes of an octave blend so well?
rows.translation: Zakaj se tona oktave tako dobro zlijeta?
rows.context: Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-3 “The octave” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-3 “The octave” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The top one vibrates twice as fast
rows.context: Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-3 “The octave” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-3 “The octave” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The top note vibrates exactly twice as fast as the bottom one, so their waves line up.
rows.translation: Zgornji ton niha točno dvakrat hitreje od spodnjega, zato se njuni valovanji ujemata.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-3 “The octave” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-3 “The octave” · step 7 (along) · title
Singing · Unit 4 · challenge voc-4-4 “Leaps and landings” · title

rows.source: Hear each leap in your head before you sing it. Land lightly on the top note, then step home.
rows.translation: Vsak skok najprej zasliši v mislih, nato ga zapoj. Lahkotno pristani na zgornjem tonu, nato stopaj domov.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 4 · challenge voc-4-4 “Leaps and landings” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Singing · Unit 4 · challenge voc-4-4 “Leaps and landings” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: High do, sol, mi, do: back down.
rows.translation: Visoki do, sol, mi, do: nazaj navzdol.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 4 · challenge voc-4-4 “Leaps and landings” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: What is the interval from do to the next do?
rows.translation: Kateri interval je od do do naslednjega do?
rows.context: Singing · Unit 4 · challenge voc-4-4 “Leaps and landings” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
Singing · Unit 4 · challenge voc-4-4 “Leaps and landings” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Singing · Unit 4 · challenge voc-4-4 “Leaps and landings” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Do to the next do spans eight scale notes: an octave.
rows.translation: Od do do naslednjega do je osem lestvičnih tonov: oktava.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 4 · challenge voc-4-4 “Leaps and landings” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Five public-domain tunes, melody only, at an easy pace.
rows.translation: Pet melodij v javni domeni, samo melodija, v lahkotnem tempu.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 5 “Melodies” · unit summary
Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-1 “Twinkle Twinkle Little Star” · title
Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-1 “Twinkle Twinkle Little Star” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: This traditional melody leaps up, then steps back down home. Sing it on "loo" and give each repeated note a fresh start.
rows.translation: Ta tradicionalna melodija skoči navzgor, nato po korakih nazaj domov. Poj jo na »lu« in vsak ponovljeni ton začni sveže.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-1 “Twinkle Twinkle Little Star” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The opening leap: C up to G, step to A, back to G.
rows.translation: Začetni skok: od C navzgor do G, korak do A, nazaj na G.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-1 “Twinkle Twinkle Little Star” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: The middle phrase: does it go up or down?
rows.translation: Srednja fraza: gre navzgor ali navzdol?
rows.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-1 “Twinkle Twinkle Little Star” · step 4 (listen) · question or instruction
Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-1 “Twinkle Twinkle Little Star” · step 5 (along) · title
Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-2 “Ode to Joy” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: This melody from Beethoven's Ninth Symphony moves almost entirely by step. Keep it smooth and even, like walking up and down a staircase.
rows.translation: Ta melodija iz Beethovnove Devete simfonije se premika skoraj samo po korakih. Ohrani jo gladko in enakomerno, kot hojo gor in dol po stopnicah.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-2 “Ode to Joy” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The five notes the tune lives on: F up to C.
rows.translation: Pet tonov, na katerih živi melodija: od F navzgor do C.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-2 “Ode to Joy” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: The first phrase ends with a dotted note. How does it feel?
rows.translation: Prva fraza se konča z noto s piko. Kakšen je občutek?
rows.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-2 “Ode to Joy” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-2 “Ode to Joy” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The dotted note is held longer, then a short note leads into the last one.
rows.translation: Nota s piko traja dlje, nato kratka nota vodi v zadnjo.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-2 “Ode to Joy” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-3 “Auld Lang Syne” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: This traditional Scottish melody starts with a pickup, a note before the first full bar. Sing it lightly, then lean on the next note.
rows.translation: Ta tradicionalna škotska melodija se začne s predtaktom, noto pred prvim polnim taktom. Zapoj jo lahkotno, nato poudari naslednji ton.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-3 “Auld Lang Syne” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The climb in the third bar: F, A, C, up to D.
rows.translation: Vzpon v tretjem taktu: F, A, C, navzgor do D.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-3 “Auld Lang Syne” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-3 “Auld Lang Syne” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: The loudest note of a song
rows.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-3 “Auld Lang Syne” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-3 “Auld Lang Syne” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A note before the first full bar
rows.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-3 “Auld Lang Syne” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A pickup leads into beat 1 of the first full bar.
rows.translation: Predtakt vodi v dobo 1 prvega polnega takta.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-3 “Auld Lang Syne” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: This American hymn tune from the early 1800s is in 3/4: count 1, 2, 3. Long notes often turn into a quick pair, so keep the pair light.
rows.translation: Ta ameriška cerkvena melodija iz začetka stoletja po letu 1800 je v 3/4: štej 1, 2, 3. Dolgi toni pogosto preidejo v hiter par, zato naj bo par lahkoten.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-4 “Amazing Grace” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The quick turn: F, up to A, back to F.
rows.translation: Hitri obrat: F, navzgor do A, nazaj na F.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-4 “Amazing Grace” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: How many beats are in each bar of this hymn?
rows.translation: Koliko dob je v vsakem taktu te cerkvene pesmi?
rows.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-4 “Amazing Grace” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: It's in 3/4: three beats per bar, with the weight on 1.
rows.translation: Je v 3/4: tri dobe na takt, s poudarkom na 1.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-4 “Amazing Grace” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-5 “Shenandoah” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: This American folk song from the 1800s moves slowly, with wide leaps. Breathe at each rest, and hear every leap before you sing it.
rows.translation: Ta ameriška ljudska pesem iz stoletja z začetkom leta 1800 se premika počasi, z velikimi skoki. Vdihni pri vsaki pavzi in vsak skok zasliši, preden ga zapoješ.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-5 “Shenandoah” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The opening leap: low G up to C. Any octave counts.
rows.translation: Začetni skok: od nizkega G navzgor do C. Vsaka oktava šteje.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-5 “Shenandoah” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: The big leap: G up to high C, then step down.
rows.translation: Veliki skok: od G navzgor do visokega C, nato po korakih navzdol.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-5 “Shenandoah” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Where should you breathe in this song?
rows.translation: Kje naj vdihneš v tej pesmi?
rows.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-5 “Shenandoah” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction
Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-5 “Shenandoah” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Never; sing it in one breath
rows.translation: Nikoli; zapoj jo z enim vdihom
rows.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-5 “Shenandoah” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The rests mark the ends of phrases. Breathe there so each line has full support.
rows.translation: Pavze označujejo konce fraz. Tam vdihni, da ima vsaka vrstica polno oporo.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-5 “Shenandoah” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

Singing · Unit 5 · challenge voc-5-6 “Medley” · title

rows.source: Five tunes back to back, one phrase each. Breathe at every rest, and give repeated notes a fresh start.
rows.translation: Pet melodij druga za drugo, po ena fraza iz vsake. Vdihni pri vsaki pavzi in ponovljene tone začni sveže.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 5 · challenge voc-5-6 “Medley” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which of these songs is in 3/4?
rows.translation: Katera od teh pesmi je v 3/4?
rows.context: Singing · Unit 5 · challenge voc-5-6 “Medley” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Amazing Grace counts 1, 2, 3 in every bar.
rows.translation: V Amazing Grace vsak takt šteje 1, 2, 3.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 5 · challenge voc-5-6 “Medley” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Singing · Unit 6 “Control” · title

rows.source: Hold notes steady, shape loud and soft, and warm up well.
rows.translation: Drži tone enakomerno, oblikuj glasno in tiho ter se dobro ogrej.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 “Control” · unit summary
Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-1 “Hold it steady” · title
Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-1 “Hold it steady” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Pitch drifts when the air behind it changes. Keep a low, even breath and watch the note stay centered from start to finish.
rows.translation: Višina tona odtava, ko se zrak za njim spremeni. Ohrani nizek, enakomeren dih in opazuj, kako ton od začetka do konca ostaja na sredini.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-1 “Hold it steady” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Hold G and keep it centered.
rows.translation: Drži G in ga ohrani na sredini.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-1 “Hold it steady” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-1 “Hold it steady” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: Notes often sag flat as your air runs out. Stop a little before you're empty, then take a fresh low breath.
rows.translation: Toni pogosto zdrsnejo prenizko, ko zmanjkuje zraka. Ustavi se malo prej, nato znova nizko vdihni.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-1 “Hold it steady” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Your long notes go flat at the end. What helps?
rows.translation: Tvoji dolgi toni so na koncu prenizki. Kaj pomaga?
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-1 “Hold it steady” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: End the note sooner and breathe
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-1 “Hold it steady” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-1 “Hold it steady” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-1 “Hold it steady” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Pitch sags when you run low on air. Ending a bit early keeps the whole note in tune.
rows.translation: Višina zdrsne, ko zmanjkuje zraka. Če končaš malo prej, ves ton ostane čist.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-1 “Hold it steady” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-1 “Hold it steady” · step 5 (along) · title
Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-1 “Hold it steady” · step 6 (along) · title
Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-2 “Vibrato basics” · title

rows.source: Vibrato is a gentle, regular wave in pitch, around five to seven times a second. It grows out of a relaxed throat and steady breath, not out of shaking.
rows.translation: Vibrato je nežno, pravilno valovanje višine, približno pet- do sedemkrat na sekundo. Razvije se iz sproščenega grla in enakomernega diha, ne iz tresenja.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-2 “Vibrato basics” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Where does healthy vibrato come from?
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-2 “Vibrato basics” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-2 “Vibrato basics” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer
Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-2 “Vibrato basics” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A relaxed throat and steady breath
rows.translation: Iz sproščenega grla in enakomernega diha
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-2 “Vibrato basics” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Vibrato appears when the voice is free and supported. Forcing it from the jaw or belly makes a wobble.
rows.translation: Vibrato se pojavi, ko je glas svoboden in podprt. Siljenje iz čeljusti ali trebuha ustvari nihanje.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-2 “Vibrato basics” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-2 “Vibrato basics” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: Learn to hold a straight, steady note before you chase vibrato. When your voice is relaxed and supported, vibrato often appears on its own.
rows.translation: Nauči se držati raven, enakomeren ton, preden iščeš vibrato. Ko je glas sproščen in podprt, se vibrato pogosto pojavi sam.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-2 “Vibrato basics” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: A straight, steady A. No wave, just a clear line.
rows.translation: Raven, enakomeren A. Brez valovanja, le čista črta.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-2 “Vibrato basics” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: What's the best first goal for a new singer?
rows.translation: Kateri je najboljši prvi cilj za pevca začetnika?
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-2 “Vibrato basics” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-2 “Vibrato basics” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-2 “Vibrato basics” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-2 “Vibrato basics” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A steady tone is the foundation. Vibrato that grows from it sounds natural.
rows.translation: Enakomeren ton je temelj. Vibrato, ki se razvije iz njega, zveni naravno.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-2 “Vibrato basics” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-2 “Vibrato basics” · step 6 (along) · title
Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-3 “Loud and soft” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Dynamics are how loud or soft you sing. Get louder with more breath energy, not by squeezing your throat. The pitch should stay put.
rows.translation: Dinamika pomeni, kako glasno ali tiho poješ. Glasnost povečaj z več energije diha, ne s stiskanjem grla. Višina tona naj ostane ista.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-3 “Loud and soft” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Sing E softly, then louder on the same pitch.
rows.translation: Zapoj E tiho, nato glasneje na isti višini.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-3 “Loud and soft” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: As you get louder, what can happen to pitch?
rows.translation: Kaj se lahko zgodi z višino tona, ko poješ glasneje?

rows.source: Extra push tends to raise the pitch, and very soft notes can sag flat. Watch the note either way.
rows.translation: Večji pritisk pogosto zviša ton, zelo tihi toni pa lahko zdrsnejo prenizko. V obeh primerih spremljaj ton.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-3 “Loud and soft” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-3 “Loud and soft” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: A swell grows from soft to louder and back on one breath. Start quietly, grow gently, then fade, all on the same pitch.
rows.translation: Pri naraščanju ton z enim vdihom preide iz tihega v glasnejšega in nazaj. Začni tiho, nežno naraščaj, nato pojemaj, ves čas na isti višini.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-3 “Loud and soft” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Swell on G: soft, louder, soft. Keep it centered.
rows.translation: Oblikuj G: tiho, glasneje, tiho. Ohrani ga na sredini.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-3 “Loud and soft” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise

Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-4 “Your warm-up routine” · title
Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-4 “Your warm-up routine” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A short warm-up eases your voice in: breathe low, hum, lip trill, then sing a scale. Start in the middle of your range and stay comfortable.
rows.translation: Kratko ogrevanje nežno pripravi glas: dihaj nizko, mrmraj, naredi ustnični trilček, nato zapoj lestvico. Začni na sredini svojega obsega in ostani pri udobnem.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-4 “Your warm-up routine” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Your voice feels tired after practice. What's best?
rows.translation: Po vadbi je glas utrujen. Kaj je najbolje?
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-4 “Your warm-up routine” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-4 “Your warm-up routine” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Dati mu počitek in piti vodo po požirkih
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-4 “Your warm-up routine” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Rest helps a tired voice recover. If hoarseness lingers for a few weeks, check with a doctor.
rows.translation: Počitek pomaga utrujenemu glasu okrevati. Če hripavost traja nekaj tednov, se posvetuj z zdravnikom.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-4 “Your warm-up routine” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Singing · Unit 6 · challenge voc-6-5 “Control check” · title

rows.source: Warm up first. Then hold each note steady, shape it soft and loud, and breathe before you run out.
rows.translation: Najprej se ogrej. Nato vsak ton drži enakomerno, ga oblikuj tiho in glasno ter vdihni, preden zmanjka zraka.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · challenge voc-6-5 “Control check” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Singing · Unit 6 · challenge voc-6-5 “Control check” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
Singing · Unit 6 · challenge voc-6-5 “Control check” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Singing · Unit 6 · challenge voc-6-5 “Control check” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Singing · Unit 6 · challenge voc-6-5 “Control check” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Vibrato is a gentle, even wave around the note, a few times a second.
rows.translation: Vibrato je nežno, enakomerno valovanje okoli tona, nekajkrat na sekundo.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · challenge voc-6-5 “Control check” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: To sing louder, what do you add?
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · challenge voc-6-5 “Control check” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction
Singing · Unit 6 · challenge voc-6-5 “Control check” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
Singing · Unit 6 · challenge voc-6-5 “Control check” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
Singing · Unit 6 · challenge voc-6-5 “Control check” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Breath energy makes a bigger sound without strain.
rows.translation: Energija diha ustvari večji zvok brez naprezanja.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · challenge voc-6-5 “Control check” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Play the melody, or strum the chords and sing
rows.translation: Igraj melodijo ali brenkaj akorde in poj
rows.context: Songs course · course subtitle
Songs · Unit 1 “First songs” · title

rows.source: Six famous tunes, one note at a time, on the top strings. Slow tempos, big wins.
rows.translation: Šest znanih melodij, po en ton na zgornjih strunah. Počasni tempi, veliki uspehi.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 1 “First songs” · unit summary
Songs · Unit 1 · song song-mary “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: In 1877, Thomas Edison recited this rhyme to test his new phonograph. The tune uses C and D on string 2, then open E, and G at fret 3 on string 1.
rows.translation: Leta 1877 je Thomas Edison recitiral to pesmico, da bi preizkusil novi fonograf. Melodija uporablja C in D na struni 2, nato prazni E in G pri prečki 3 na struni 1.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-mary “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: E D C D E E E: open string 1, then string 2 at frets 3 and 1, and back.
rows.translation: E D C D E E E: prazna struna 1, nato struna 2 pri prečkah 3 in 1 ter nazaj.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-mary “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: D D D at fret 3 on string 2. Then open E, and G at fret 3 on string 1.
rows.translation: D D D pri prečki 3 na struni 2. Nato prazni E in G pri prečki 3 na struni 1.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-mary “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Songs · Unit 1 · song song-twinkle “Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: This melody was first printed in France in 1761, and Mozart later wrote twelve variations on it. It leaps up, then steps down across strings 2 and 3.
rows.translation: Ta melodija je bila prvič natisnjena v Franciji leta 1761, Mozart pa je pozneje nanjo napisal dvanajst variacij. Skoči navzgor, nato se po korakih spušča čez struni 2 in 3.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-twinkle “Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Open G, a leap up to D at fret 3 on string 2, open E, and back to D.
rows.translation: Prazni G, skok navzgor do D pri prečki 3 na struni 2, prazni E in nazaj do D.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-twinkle “Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Step down in pairs: C at fret 1, open B, A at fret 2 on string 3, open G.
rows.translation: Spuščaj se v parih: C pri prečki 1, prazni B, A pri prečki 2 na struni 3, prazni G.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-twinkle “Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Which other song uses this same tune?
rows.translation: Katera druga pesem uporablja isto melodijo?
rows.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-twinkle “Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
Songs · Unit 1 · song song-twinkle “Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The alphabet song and Baa, Baa, Black Sheep both borrow this French melody.
rows.translation: Abecedna pesem in Baa, Baa, Black Sheep si obe izposodita to francosko melodijo.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-twinkle “Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Songs · Unit 1 · song song-twinkle “Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star” · step 5 (along) · title
Songs · Unit 1 · song song-ode-to-joy “Ode to Joy” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Beethoven finished his Ninth Symphony in 1824, and this melody is now the anthem of the European Union. Here you'll play the whole tune, middle section included.
rows.translation: Beethoven je Deveto simfonijo dokončal leta 1824, ta melodija pa je danes himna Evropske unije. Tu zaigraš celotno melodijo, vključno s srednjim delom.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-ode-to-joy “Ode to Joy” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The opening: E E F G G F E D, one step at a time.
rows.translation: Začetek: E E F G G F E D, po en korak.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-ode-to-joy “Ode to Joy” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Songs · Unit 1 · song song-ode-to-joy “Ode to Joy” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: In the middle section, E and F share a single beat. Count one, two-and, three, four, and play E on two and F on the and.
rows.translation: V srednjem delu si E in F delita eno dobo. Štej ena, dve-in, tri, štiri ter igraj E na dve in F na in.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-ode-to-joy “Ode to Joy” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The middle: quick E F pairs on string 1, then down to open G on string 3.
rows.translation: Sredina: hitri pari E F na struni 1, nato navzdol do praznega G na struni 3.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-ode-to-joy “Ode to Joy” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Songs · Unit 1 · song song-ode-to-joy “Ode to Joy” · step 6 (along) · title
Songs · Unit 1 · song song-frere-jacques “Frère Jacques” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Frère Jacques is a French round, first printed around 1780: a second player starts the same tune two bars later, and the parts fit together.
rows.translation: Frère Jacques je francoski kanon, prvič natisnjen okoli leta 1780: drugi glasbenik začne isto melodijo dva takta pozneje in parta se ujameta.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-frere-jacques “Frère Jacques” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In a round, the second player…
rows.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-frere-jacques “Frère Jacques” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
Songs · Unit 1 · song song-frere-jacques “Frère Jacques” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer
Songs · Unit 1 · song song-frere-jacques “Frère Jacques” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer
Songs · Unit 1 · song song-frere-jacques “Frère Jacques” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Everyone plays the same melody, each starting a little later. The phrases are built to fit on top of each other.
rows.translation: Vsi igrajo isto melodijo, vsak začne malo pozneje. Fraze so sestavljene tako, da se prilegajo druga nad drugo.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-frere-jacques “Frère Jacques” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: The quick part: D E D C on strings 2 and 1, then B and G.
rows.translation: Hitri del: D E D C na strunah 2 in 1, nato B in G.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-frere-jacques “Frère Jacques” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Songs · Unit 1 · song song-frere-jacques “Frère Jacques” · step 4 (along) · title

rows.source: The ending dips from open G to open D on string 4, then comes back.
rows.translation: Konec se spusti s praznega G na prazni D na struni 4, nato se vrne.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-frere-jacques “Frère Jacques” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise

Songs · Unit 1 · song song-jingle-bells “Jingle Bells” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: James Lord Pierpont published this song in 1857 as One Horse Open Sleigh. You'll play its famous chorus, all on strings 1 and 2.
rows.translation: James Lord Pierpont je pesem leta 1857 objavil kot One Horse Open Sleigh. Igral boš njen slavni refren, v celoti na strunah 1 in 2.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-jingle-bells “Jingle Bells” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Open E, G at fret 3, down to C and D on string 2, then home to E.
rows.translation: Prazni E, G pri prečki 3, navzdol do C in D na struni 2, nato domov na E.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-jingle-bells “Jingle Bells” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Songs · Unit 1 · song song-jingle-bells “Jingle Bells” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: In that phrase, C rings for a beat and a half and D slips in on the and of four. Count one, two, three, four-and.
rows.translation: V tej frazi C zveni dobo in pol, D pa zdrsne noter na in za štiri. Štej ena, dve, tri, štiri-in.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-jingle-bells “Jingle Bells” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The second line sits on F at fret 1, then settles onto open E.
rows.translation: Druga vrstica obstane na F pri prečki 1, nato se umiri na praznem E.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-jingle-bells “Jingle Bells” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Songs · Unit 1 · song song-jingle-bells “Jingle Bells” · arrangement · song section label (Intro, Verse 1 …) on a small chip

rows.source: This traditional spiritual became a jazz standard after Louis Armstrong recorded it in 1938. It uses C, D, E, F and G on strings 2 and 1.
rows.translation: Ta tradicionalni spiritual je postal jazzovski standard, potem ko ga je leta 1938 posnel Louis Armstrong. Uporablja C, D, E, F in G na strunah 2 in 1.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-saints “When the Saints Go Marching In” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The opening: C on string 2, then E, F and G climbing string 1.
rows.translation: Začetek: C na struni 2, nato E, F in G navzgor po struni 1.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-saints “When the Saints Go Marching In” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Songs · Unit 1 · challenge song-medley-first-songs “First songs medley” · title
Songs · Unit 1 · challenge song-medley-first-songs “First songs medley” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: No new notes here: all six tunes from this unit, each a little faster than before. Name the opening by ear, then play.
rows.translation: Tu ni novih tonov: vseh šest melodij iz te enote, vsaka malo hitreje kot prej. Po posluhu prepoznaj začetek, nato igraj.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 1 · challenge song-medley-first-songs “First songs medley” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Songs · Unit 2 “Folk favorites” · title

rows.source: Campfire songs and a sea song, with easy chords to strum on the simplest ones.
rows.translation: Pesmi ob tabornem ognju in mornarska pesem, z lahkimi akordi za brenkanje pri najpreprostejših.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 2 “Folk favorites” · unit summary
Songs · Unit 2 · song song-oh-susanna “Oh! Susanna” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Stephen Foster published this song in 1848, and gold seekers heading to California made it their anthem. The verse sits on strings 3, 2 and 1.
rows.translation: Stephen Foster je pesem objavil leta 1848, iskalci zlata na poti v Kalifornijo pa so jo vzeli za svojo himno. Kitica se igra na strunah 3, 2 in 1.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-oh-susanna “Oh! Susanna” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Open B, D at fret 3, open E, then back down to open G and A at fret 2.
rows.translation: Prazni B, D pri prečki 3, prazni E, nato nazaj navzdol do praznega G in A pri prečki 2.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-oh-susanna “Oh! Susanna” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: The last bar: B B A A, then home to open G.
rows.translation: Zadnji takt: B B A A, nato domov na prazni G.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-oh-susanna “Oh! Susanna” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Songs · Unit 2 · song song-oh-susanna “Oh! Susanna” · step 6 (explain) · title

rows.source: G sounds like home, and D7 pulls back toward it. The verse is three bars of G, one of D7, two of G, then D7 and G.
rows.translation: G zveni kot dom, D7 pa vleče nazaj k njemu. Kitica ima tri takte G, enega D7, dva G, nato D7 in G.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-oh-susanna “Oh! Susanna” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text
Songs · Unit 2 · song song-camptown-races “Camptown Races” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Stephen Foster wrote this racing song in 1850, two years after Oh! Susanna. It uses the same notes and the same two chords.
rows.translation: Stephen Foster je to pesem o dirkah napisal leta 1850, dve leti po Oh! Susanna. Uporablja iste tone in ista dva akorda.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-camptown-races “Camptown Races” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: D D B D, up to open E, then D and B. Strings 2 and 1.
rows.translation: D D B D, navzgor do praznega E, nato D in B. Struni 2 in 1.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-camptown-races “Camptown Races” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Twice in the first line, a quick B leads into an A that rings for three beats. Pick the A once and let it ring.
rows.translation: Dvakrat v prvi vrstici hitri B vodi v A, ki zveni tri dobe. A uberi enkrat in ga pusti zveneti.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-camptown-races “Camptown Races” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
Songs · Unit 2 · song song-old-macdonald “Old MacDonald Had a Farm” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: This farmyard song was first printed in 1917, but people sang versions of it long before. Its tune reaches down to D and E on string 4.
rows.translation: Ta pesem o kmetiji je bila prvič natisnjena leta 1917, a ljudje so njene različice peli že dolgo prej. Melodija sega navzdol do D in E na struni 4.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-old-macdonald “Old MacDonald Had a Farm” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Open G three times, down to open D, E at fret 2 on string 4, back to D.
rows.translation: Trikrat prazni G, navzdol do praznega D, E pri prečki 2 na struni 4, nazaj na D.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-old-macdonald “Old MacDonald Had a Farm” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Then up: open B twice, A at fret 2 on string 3, and home to open G.
rows.translation: Nato navzgor: dvakrat prazni B, A pri prečki 2 na struni 3 in domov na prazni G.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-old-macdonald “Old MacDonald Had a Farm” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Songs · Unit 2 · song song-old-macdonald “Old MacDonald Had a Farm” · step 6 (explain) · title

rows.source: Here each chord lasts two beats, so the strum counts one, two. The order is G, G, C, G, then G, D7, G, G. Change early.
rows.translation: Tu vsak akord traja dve dobi, zato brenkanje šteje ena, dve. Vrstni red je G, G, C, G, nato G, D7, G, G. Menjaj zgodaj.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-old-macdonald “Old MacDonald Had a Farm” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text
Songs · Unit 2 · song song-old-macdonald “Old MacDonald Had a Farm” · arrangement · lyric credit (a name and year: usually keep as is)
Songs · Unit 2 · song song-yankee-doodle “Yankee Doodle” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: British soldiers first sang this tune to mock American colonists. By the end of the Revolution, the Americans had made it their own.
rows.translation: Britanski vojaki so to melodijo sprva peli za posmeh ameriškim kolonistom. Do konca revolucije so jo Američani vzeli za svojo.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-yankee-doodle “Yankee Doodle” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: C C D E, C E D, then a drop to open G on string 3.
rows.translation: C C D E, C E D, nato spust na prazni G na struni 3.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-yankee-doodle “Yankee Doodle” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: The first half ends on B. How does that feel?
rows.translation: Prva polovica se konča na B. Kakšen je občutek?
rows.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-yankee-doodle “Yankee Doodle” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
Songs · Unit 2 · song song-yankee-doodle “Yankee Doodle” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: B sits just below C and leans toward it. The second half answers by landing on C.
rows.translation: B je tik pod C in teži k njemu. Druga polovica odgovori s pristankom na C.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-yankee-doodle “Yankee Doodle” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: The last line: down from F on string 1, dip to open G, then climb back to C.
rows.translation: Zadnja vrstica: navzdol od F na struni 1, spust do praznega G, nato vzpon nazaj do C.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-yankee-doodle “Yankee Doodle” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: The chorus sits low: A at fret 2 on string 3, open B, then F and E on string 4 and C on string 5.
rows.translation: Refren je nizko: A pri prečki 2 na struni 3, prazni B, nato F in E na struni 4 ter C na struni 5.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-yankee-doodle “Yankee Doodle” · step 7 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Songs · Unit 2 · song song-yankee-doodle “Yankee Doodle” · arrangement · lyric credit (a name and year: usually keep as is)
Songs · Unit 2 · song song-aura-lee “Aura Lee” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: George Poulton published this ballad in 1861. Nearly a century later, its melody became the tune of Love Me Tender.
rows.translation: George Poulton je to balado objavil leta 1861. Skoraj stoletje pozneje je njena melodija postala napev pesmi Love Me Tender.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-aura-lee “Aura Lee” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Up to C, down to open B and back, then D, a dip to A, and D again.
rows.translation: Navzgor do C, navzdol do praznega B in nazaj, nato D, spust do A in spet D.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-aura-lee “Aura Lee” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Songs · Unit 2 · song song-aura-lee “Aura Lee” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: Aura Lee is a slow ballad. Keep each finger down until the next note sounds, so the notes join smoothly.
rows.translation: Aura Lee je počasna balada. Vsak prst pusti spodaj, dokler ne zazveni naslednji ton, da se toni gladko povežejo.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-aura-lee “Aura Lee” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The high part: open E, F at fret 1, then down to D, A, and D again.
rows.translation: Visoki del: prazni E, F pri prečki 1, nato navzdol do D, A in spet D.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-aura-lee “Aura Lee” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Songs · Unit 2 · song song-aura-lee “Aura Lee” · step 6 (along) · title
Songs · Unit 2 · song song-bobby-shafto “Bobby Shafto” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: This song from the north of England is about Bobby Shafto, gone to sea. Its words were in print by 1805, and fiddlers played its tune for dances by 1770.
rows.translation: Ta pesem iz severne Anglije govori o Bobbyju Shaftu, ki je odšel na morje. Besedilo je bilo natisnjeno že do leta 1805, violinisti pa so melodijo za plese igrali že do leta 1770.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-bobby-shafto “Bobby Shafto” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Open B, D at fret 3, back to B and open G, then B, D and B again.
rows.translation: Prazni B, D pri prečki 3, nazaj do B in praznega G, nato B, D in spet B.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-bobby-shafto “Bobby Shafto” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Songs · Unit 2 · song song-bobby-shafto “Bobby Shafto” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: The second line dips to F sharp: string 4, fret 4, with your little finger. Keep your hand over the first four frets so it's ready.
rows.translation: Druga vrstica se spusti do F z višajem: struna 4, prečka 4, z mezincem. Roko ohrani nad prvimi štirimi prečkami, da bo pripravljena.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-bobby-shafto “Bobby Shafto” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: A at fret 2 on string 3, C at fret 1 on string 2, A, down to F sharp, and back up.
rows.translation: A pri prečki 2 na struni 3, C pri prečki 1 na struni 2, A, navzdol do F z višajem in nazaj navzgor.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-bobby-shafto “Bobby Shafto” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Songs · Unit 2 · song song-bobby-shafto “Bobby Shafto” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: The first three lines end the same way: two notes of one beat, then one of two beats. Gone to sea, on his knee, marry me.
rows.translation: Prve tri vrstice se končajo enako: dve enodobni noti, nato ena dvodobna. Gone to sea, on his knee, marry me.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-bobby-shafto “Bobby Shafto” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
Songs · Unit 2 · song song-bobby-shafto “Bobby Shafto” · step 9 (explain) · title

rows.source: The verse needs only the two chords from Oh! Susanna: two bars of G, two of D7, two of G, then D7 and G.
rows.translation: Kitica potrebuje le akorda iz Oh! Susanna: dva takta G, dva D7, dva G, nato D7 in G.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-bobby-shafto “Bobby Shafto” · step 9 (explain) · lesson card text
Songs · Unit 2 · song song-bobby-shafto “Bobby Shafto” · arrangement · lyric credit (a name and year: usually keep as is)
Songs · Unit 2 · challenge song-medley-folk “Folk medley” · title
Songs · Unit 2 · challenge song-medley-folk “Folk medley” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: No new notes or chords: all six songs from this unit, one after another, each a little faster than before.
rows.translation: Brez novih tonov ali akordov: vseh šest pesmi iz te enote, ena za drugo, vsaka nekoliko hitreje kot prej.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 2 · challenge song-medley-folk “Folk medley” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Songs · Unit 3 “Classical themes I” · title

rows.source: Famous themes by Pachelbel, Dvořák, Brahms, Petzold, Grieg and Beethoven, in first position.
rows.translation: Znamenite teme Pachelbla, Dvořáka, Brahmsa, Petzolda, Griega in Beethovna v prvi legi.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 3 “Classical themes I” · unit summary
Songs · Unit 3 · song song-canon-in-d “Canon in D” · title
Songs · Unit 3 · song song-canon-in-d “Canon in D” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Johann Pachelbel wrote this canon over 300 years ago. Its bass repeats the same eight notes the whole way through while violins weave melodies above.
rows.translation: Johann Pachelbel je ta kanon napisal pred več kot 300 leti. Bas ves čas ponavlja istih osem tonov, violine pa nad njim prepletajo melodije.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-canon-in-d “Canon in D” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The bass, moved up an octave: D, A, B, F sharp, G, D, G, A.
rows.translation: Bas, prestavljen oktavo više: D, A, B, F z višajem, G, D, G, A.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-canon-in-d “Canon in D” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: What does the bass do all through the Canon?
rows.translation: Kaj počne bas skozi ves Kanon?
rows.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-canon-in-d “Canon in D” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
Songs · Unit 3 · song song-canon-in-d “Canon in D” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Plays a new tune each time
rows.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-canon-in-d “Canon in D” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Songs · Unit 3 · song song-canon-in-d “Canon in D” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A repeating bass like this is called a ground. Everything else in the piece is built on top of it.
rows.translation: Tak ponavljajoči se bas imenujemo ostinatni bas. Vse drugo v skladbi je zgrajeno nad njim.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-canon-in-d “Canon in D” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Songs · Unit 3 · song song-canon-in-d “Canon in D” · step 4 (along) · title
Songs · Unit 3 · song song-canon-in-d “Canon in D” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: A sharp is one fret above its letter. The melody uses C sharp on string 2, fret 2, and F sharp on string 4, fret 4. Reach that one with your little finger.
rows.translation: Ton z višajem je eno prečko nad tonom brez predznaka. Melodija uporablja C z višajem na struni 2, prečki 2, in F z višajem na struni 4, prečki 4. Tega dosezi z mezincem.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-canon-in-d “Canon in D” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The first violin line: down from F sharp on string 1, then back up to C sharp.
rows.translation: Prva violinska melodija: navzdol od F z višajem na struni 1, nato nazaj navzgor do C z višajem.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-canon-in-d “Canon in D” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Songs · Unit 3 · song song-canon-in-d “Canon in D” · step 7 (along) · title
Songs · Unit 3 · song song-canon-in-d “Canon in D” · arrangement · song section label (Intro, Verse 1 …) on a small chip

rows.translation: Largo iz simfonije Iz novega sveta
rows.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-largo “Largo, New World Symphony” · title
Songs · Unit 3 · song song-largo “Largo, New World Symphony” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Antonín Dvořák wrote this theme for English horn in 1893, in his Symphony From the New World, while he was living in New York.
rows.translation: Antonín Dvořák je to temo za angleški rog napisal leta 1893 v svoji simfoniji Iz novega sveta, ko je živel v New Yorku.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-largo “Largo, New World Symphony” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Open E, G at fret 3 on string 1, back to E, then D and C on string 2.
rows.translation: Prazni E, G na prečki 3 strune 1, nazaj na E, nato D in C na struni 2.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-largo “Largo, New World Symphony” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Most bars open with a long note and a quick one. Count one, two-and, three: the quick note lands on the and of two.
rows.translation: Večina taktov se začne z dolgim in kratkim tonom. Štej ena, dve-in, tri: kratki ton pride na in druge dobe.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-largo “Largo, New World Symphony” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The ending: D, E, D, then settle on C and let it ring.
rows.translation: Zaključek: D, E, D, nato se ustavi na C in pusti, da zveni.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-largo “Largo, New World Symphony” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Songs · Unit 3 · song song-largo “Largo, New World Symphony” · arrangement · song section label (Intro, Verse 1 …) on a small chip
Songs · Unit 3 · song song-brahms-lullaby “Brahms' Lullaby” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Johannes Brahms wrote this lullaby in 1868 for a friend's newborn son. It sways in three, like a cradle: a long note, then two quick ones.
rows.translation: Johannes Brahms je to uspavanko napisal leta 1868 za prijateljičinega novorojenega sina. Ziblje se v treh dobah kakor zibelka: dolg ton, nato dva kratka.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-brahms-lullaby “Brahms' Lullaby” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The opening rocks between open B and D at fret 3 on string 2.
rows.translation: Začetek niha med praznim B in D na prečki 3 strune 2.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-brahms-lullaby “Brahms' Lullaby” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Open G on string 3, then the same note an octave higher: G at fret 3 on string 1.
rows.translation: Prazni G na struni 3, nato isti ton oktavo više: G na prečki 3 strune 1.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-brahms-lullaby “Brahms' Lullaby” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Songs · Unit 3 · song song-minuet-in-g “Minuet in G” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: This minuet appears in a 1725 notebook Bach gave his wife, Anna Magdalena. Scholars now credit it to his fellow composer Christian Petzold.
rows.translation: Ta menuet je v zvezku iz leta 1725, ki ga je Bach podaril ženi Anni Magdaleni. Raziskovalci ga danes pripisujejo njegovemu skladateljskemu kolegu Christianu Petzoldu.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-minuet-in-g “Minuet in G” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: D at fret 3 on string 2, then climb from open G: A, B, C, D. Then two open Gs.
rows.translation: D na prečki 3 strune 2, nato navzgor od praznega G: A, B, C, D. Nato dva prazna tona G.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-minuet-in-g “Minuet in G” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: A minuet is a dance in three. Most bars start with a long beat, then quick pairs: one, two-and, three-and.
rows.translation: Menuet je ples v treh dobah. Večina taktov se začne z dolgim tonom, nato sledijo hitri pari: ena, dve-in, tri-in.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-minuet-in-g “Minuet in G” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Open E, back to C and D on string 2, then E, F sharp and G on string 1.
rows.translation: Prazni E, nazaj na C in D na struni 2, nato E, F z višajem in G na struni 1.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-minuet-in-g “Minuet in G” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: The ending: A B A G, then F sharp at fret 4 on string 4, and home to G.
rows.translation: Zaključek: A B A G, nato F z višajem na prečki 4 strune 4 in domov na G.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-minuet-in-g “Minuet in G” · step 7 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: The second section starts low: open B, A, open D, then C sharp at fret 4 and B at fret 2 on string 5, and open A.
rows.translation: Drugi del se začne nizko: prazni B, A, prazni D, nato C z višajem na prečki 4 in B na prečki 2 strune 5 ter prazni A.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-minuet-in-g “Minuet in G” · step 8 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: In the Hall of the Mountain King
rows.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-mountain-king “In the Hall of the Mountain King” · title
Songs · Unit 3 · song song-mountain-king “In the Hall of the Mountain King” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Grieg wrote this for the play Peer Gynt in 1875. It pictures trolls in their king's hall, and it starts quietly and keeps speeding up.
rows.translation: Grieg je to napisal za igro Peer Gynt leta 1875. Prikazuje trole v kraljevi dvorani, začne se tiho in postaja vse hitrejše.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-mountain-king “In the Hall of the Mountain King” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Climb from open string 6: F sharp at fret 2, G at fret 3, open A, B at fret 2.
rows.translation: Od prazne strune 6 navzgor: F z višajem na prečki 2, G na prečki 3, prazni A, B na prečki 2.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-mountain-king “In the Hall of the Mountain King” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: The creeping part: A sharp at fret 1 on string 5, then open A with F at fret 1 on string 6.
rows.translation: Prikradljivi del: A z višajem na prečki 1 strune 5, nato prazni A s F na prečki 1 strune 6.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-mountain-king “In the Hall of the Mountain King” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Where is A sharp on string 5?
rows.translation: Kje je A z višajem na struni 5?
rows.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-mountain-king “In the Hall of the Mountain King” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
Songs · Unit 3 · song song-mountain-king “In the Hall of the Mountain King” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A sharp is one fret above A, and A is open string 5. So A sharp is fret 1.
rows.translation: A z višajem je eno prečko nad A, A pa je prazna struna 5. Zato je A z višajem na prečki 1.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-mountain-king “In the Hall of the Mountain King” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Songs · Unit 3 · song song-mountain-king “In the Hall of the Mountain King” · step 5 (along) · title
Songs · Unit 3 · song song-mountain-king “In the Hall of the Mountain King” · step 6 (along) · title
Songs · Unit 3 · song song-mountain-king “In the Hall of the Mountain King” · step 7 (along) · title
Songs · Unit 3 · song song-mountain-king “In the Hall of the Mountain King” · step 8 (along) · title
